objective: Diagnostico aislado READ_ONLY de la consulta TYPES del Gate3B Custodia. No DDL/DML, no cambios de repositorio, no Produccion.

queries.name: types
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND ((t.name='RH_Colaboradores_Expediente' AND c.name='ColaboradorID') OR (t.name='RH_Cat_Puestos' AND c.name='PuestoID') OR (t.name='Producto_Catalogo' AND c.name='ProductoID') OR (t.name='ActivoFijo_Activos' AND c.name='ActivoID') OR (t.name='Sistema_Empresas' AND c.name='EmpresaID') OR (t.name='Unidades_Negocio' AND c.name='id') OR (t.name='Sistema_Sucursales' AND c.name='SucursalID') OR (t.name='Usuario_Catalogo' AND c.name='UsuarioID') OR (t.name='Gobierno_Documento' AND c.name='DocumentoID') OR (t.name='RH_Nomina_Detalle' AND c.name='NominaDetalleID')) ORDER BY t.name,c.name;
